name: Qumo AI Forms
author: Qumo

sections.description:
The Qumo AI Forms Plugin allows you to integrate Qumo forms into your WordPress site. You can embed forms directly into pages or posts or add a floating chat button that opens forms in a popup window.

Features:
– Embed forms directly into pages or posts.
– Add a floating chat button for surveys, feedback, or contact forms.
– Customize appearance and behavior.
– Mobile-responsive design.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. In your WordPress admin panel, go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click on the “Upload Plugin” button.
  4. Upload the zip file and click “Install Now.”
  5. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
What is the format for the Qumo form URL?

The URL should follow this format: https://qumo.ai/s/your-form-link.

How do I obtain my Qumo form link?

  1. Log in to your Qumo AI account at https://qumo.ai.
  2. Create or select an existing form.
  3. Copy the form’s shareable link, which will look like https://qumo.ai/s/your-form-link.
  4. Paste this link into the plugin settings or block editor.

Can I customize the appearance of the chat icon?

Yes, you can customize the color, position, and text of the chat icon.
